description: Get what SF Events covers in Bay Area: how many upcoming events it lists and for which dates, when the data was last published, how many sources feed it, and upcoming events per category, topic, neighborhood and town. Call it before searching to pick valid category, topic, neighborhood and town values, or to tell a user what this site covers; it returns counts only, no events (use search_events or list_upcoming for those). Takes no arguments. No sign-in; each client gets 30 calls a minute and 2,500 event rows an hour.
name: get_city

data_generated.description: When this city's data was last published

towns.description: Upcoming events per town, the busiest first (search_events `town`)

title: Get city coverage
